[EV-GONG-TRANSCRIPT-CALL-008, EV-GONG-TRANSCRIPT-CALL-001, EV-SLACK-SLACK-1001-02] (confidence: high)
- Prepare the success-metrics section with documented baseline exception counts, targets, policy-drift visibility, and separate governance reporting from payment-readiness milestones.
